scheme_name: Ramai Awas (Gharkul) Scheme for SC & Nav-Buddha (Urban and Rural)
other_conditions: Applicant must have lived in Maharashtra for at least 15 years.
Only one person in the family can receive the benefit.
Applicant must not be receiving benefits from any other government housing scheme.
Eligibility includes members of the Nav‑Buddha community.
benefits_summary: Provides housing assistance of up to ₹1  lakh in rural areas, ₹1.5  lakh in municipal areas, and ₹2  lakh in municipal corporation areas, with beneficiary shares of 0 %, 7.5 %, and 10 % respectively.
documents_required: Hard copy of the prescribed application form
